checks.claim: Penn State FRONTIER: NRC notice of intent filed 2025-02-17 for a construction permit for a 15 MWt eVinci-based research reactor at University Park, PA.
checks.evidence: Westinghouse release dated 2025-03-04 states: "Penn State submitted a letter of intent to the NRC on February 28, 2025." The release does not give 2025-02-17. The shipped milestone for the same event already uses 2025-02-28, so the notes contradict the record's own timeline. The release also describes a letter of intent to pursue an application, not a filed construction permit application. Main session: the ADAMS letter ML25059A029 is dated 2025-02-17 (read 2026-08-23); Westinghouse gives the submission date 2025-02-28. Correction keeps both dates and says the filing is an intent to apply, not an application.
checks.correction: Penn State FRONTIER: NRC notice of intent (letter dated 2025-02-17, submitted 2025-02-28) to apply for a construction permit for a 15 MWt eVinci-based research reactor at University Park, PA.
